source_files.reuse: adapted journal transaction and history branches
format 2 decoding and attachment metadata binding

preserved_rules: Original editor_draft protobuf schema, raw TextValue values and UTF-16 offset validation
Original journal identity hash, reserved card type, canonical protobuf validation and generation CAS
Immutable source_kind/source_revision/predecessor baseline and exact source CardRecord bytes
Original historical command decoding and exact retry payload equality before any write
Historical generation is returned separately from current generation and active state
New-card draft snapshots do not create business cards and may contain empty/intermediate title
Original CreateContent/EditContent grant and HostRuntime transaction entry points
Exact idempotent discard; discarded identity cannot be resurrected
Original active slot 16, cumulative identity 256 and active byte 64 MiB limits
adaptation_boundaries: Functions receive the caller-owned serialized HostRuntime and monotonic clock rather than WorkbenchState
Existing HMOS development source uses idea format 2; production org.morrow.idea format 1/2 is not opened or migrated
Storage::prepare_write is unavailable on the development HostRuntime; protected maintenance, audit sealing, platform keys and library ownership remain unimplemented
All assets, consumed imports, predecessor operations/evidence, parent links and retirement markers are explicitly rejected by the phase gate
This does not implement editor_recovery, captured formal S1 commit proof or S1/S2 parent-child handoff
Transport and workspace UI must preserve frozen operations and avoid implicit retry when a result is unknown
Journal recognition includes reserved type or identity prefix; callers validate before excluding private records from business cards
